title: 第2章  父皇坐稳了，我要摊牌！
slug: 开局自曝系统父皇举国助我娶妻
content_zh:
日上三竿。
赵辰安终于从温柔乡中挣脱出来，只觉念头通达，神清气爽。
他穿戴整齐，一身崭新的皇子蟒袍，腰束镶玉革带。
床榻之上，乌兰雪还用被子蒙着头，只留下一头乌黑如瀑的秀发散落在枕上。
她显然是累坏了。
赵辰安没有打扰她，径直推门而出。
他必须立刻去见一个人。
他的父皇，大周王朝的唯一主宰——赵道霆！
昨夜洞房花烛后的片刻宁静里，他想通了很多事。
系统奖励的《大道天衍经》，是天品功法！
这是足以让那些高高在上的圣地、不朽神庭都打出狗脑子的无上至宝！
根据他的记忆，大周王朝作为一方王朝，皇室最顶尖的修炼功法，也不过是区区地品。
天品功法，足以改变国运！
而他赵辰安是一个无法修炼的麻瓜，根本用不上这等功法！
但他知道谁能用得上，也必须用上。
想要在这强者为尊的世界里，安稳地享受富贵。
并且源源不断地迎娶更多资质绝佳的妻子，就必须找到一棵能遮风挡雨的参天大树。
放眼整个大周王朝，谁是最大的靠山？
毫无疑问，是皇帝。
那个对他宠溺到近乎放纵的父皇！

所以，赵辰安决定做一件与所有穿越者前辈都背道而驰的事。
他要摊牌！
不再藏着掖着，而是要主动暴露自己获得了大机缘！
以此，换来父皇毫无保留的全力支持！
当然，穿越和系统是最大的隐秘，烂在肚子里也不能说。
但他可以换一种更玄乎，也更让这个世界的人信服的说法。
如此一来，他献上功法就有了完美的解释。
更重要的是，能把他爹，当今皇帝，彻底绑上他的战车！
想让大周从“王朝”晋升，甚至成为俯瞰一域的“天朝”吗？
想获得更强的功法，打破桎梏，触摸那传说中的仙台境吗？
那就帮我找老婆吧！
去找全天下最漂亮、资质最高的女人！
这计划，堪称完美！
皇宫，御书房。
身穿玄色龙袍的赵道霆正在批阅奏折，身旁的大太监魏公公垂手而立，呼吸都放得极轻。
就在这时，一个小太监碎步跑了进来，跪地禀报。
“启奏陛下，十六皇子殿下在殿外求见。”
赵道霆批阅奏折的朱笔微微一顿。
老十六？
他抬起头，神色间掠过一丝意外。

这个逆子，除了每月按例请安，平日里连皇宫的门都懒得进，今天太阳是打西边出来了？
莫非……这小子是对那天狼圣女不满，跑来跟自己诉苦了？
心头泛起一丝愧疚。
这次联姻，确实委屈他了。
最合适的人选本是尚未娶正妃的三皇子，可那混账东西抵死不从。
其余几个成年的皇子，要么已有正妃，要么其母家世显赫，根本看不上一个战败部落的女子。
挑来挑去，这桩“苦差事”只能落在他最不成器，也最没靠山的十六子赵辰安头上。
“让他进来吧。”
赵道霆放下朱笔，揉了揉眉心，已准备好迎接儿子的抱怨。
大不了，再多赏他些金银珠宝，让他出去快活就是了。
很快，身着蟒袍的赵辰安大步流星地走了进来。
“儿臣，参见父皇。”
赵辰安躬身行礼，动作干净利落，标准无比，完全不见了平日里的那份散漫与敷衍。
赵道霆打量着他，准备好的安抚之词还未出口，就见赵辰安已经直起了身。
“父皇，儿臣有天大的要事禀报！”
不等赵道霆询问，赵辰安直接开口，神情是前所未有的严肃。
“此事，关系到我大周王朝的国运兴衰，万代基业！”
赵道霆愣住了。
他看着眼前这个一脸郑重的儿子，甚至怀疑自己是不是因为批阅奏折太久，产生了幻觉。
这还是那个整日只知斗鸡走狗、眠花宿柳的混账老十六？

国运兴衰？
万代基业？
这种话从他嘴里说出来，比母猪会上树还要离谱！
“辰安，胡闹什么？”
“父皇！”
赵辰安却是坚定的向前踏出一步，目光灼灼。
“请您屏退左右！”
整个御书房瞬间落针可闻。
大太监魏公公眼观鼻，鼻观心，仿佛一尊没有听觉的雕塑。
赵道霆的表情凝重了起来。
他沉默了片刻，对着魏公公挥了挥手。
“你们都退下，守在殿外，任何人不得靠近。”
“喏。”
魏公公躬身领命，带着一众太监宫女悄无声息地退了出去，并亲手关上了厚重的殿门。
御书房内，只剩下父子二人。
赵道霆坐回龙椅，一股属于帝王的磅礴威严缓缓散开，笼罩了整个大殿。
“现在可以说了吧？”
“到底是什么事，让你如此故弄玄虚？”
然而，赵辰安依旧没有开口。
他上前几步，走到了御案之前，压低了声线。

“父皇，还不够。”
赵道霆的眉头皱成了一个川字。
“儿臣恳请父皇，动用您的修为，彻底封锁此地！”
“确保我们接下来的谈话，不会被任何存在，以任何方式探知分毫！”
此话一出，赵道霆的表情彻底变了！
他死死盯着自己的儿子，一股恐怖绝伦的气势轰然从他体内升腾而起！
那一瞬间，赵辰安只觉得一股无形的巨山当头压下，连呼吸都变得粘稠滞涩。
殿内飞舞的尘埃都在这一刻被定格在半空！
他的双腿不受控制地发软，骨骼都在呻吟，但他还是咬紧牙关。
倔强地迎着自己父皇那审视的、锐利的目光。
他必须表现出足够的慎重，才能让父皇明白，这件事的严重性，超乎想象！
当那股足以压塌山岳的气势缓缓收敛。
赵道霆深深地看了一眼赵辰安，没有多问，只是抬起手，修长的指尖在虚空中轻轻一点。
一道肉眼不可见的金色波纹以他为中心，无声无息地扩散开来，将整个御书房包裹其中。
空间，被彻底封锁！
做完这一切，赵道霆才重新开口，每一个字都重如千钧，带着不容置疑的份量。
“说。”
赵辰安终于松了口气。
他没有再多说一个字的废话，当着赵道霆的面，缓缓伸出了自己的右手。
在赵道霆惊疑不定的注视下。

赵辰安摊开手掌。
没有预兆，没有华丽的特效。
一本古朴、厚重的金色典籍，就那么凭空出现在他的掌心之上！
典籍封面上，《大道天衍经》五个古篆字，流淌着不朽的神韵，仿佛阐述着三千大道的终极至理！
赵道霆猛地从龙椅上站了起来，双目陡然圆睁，视线死死钉在那本凭空出现的功法上！
他脸上属于帝王的镇定与威严，在这一刻，荡然无存！
“天品？？？”
content_en:
Three poles in the sun.
Zhao Chenan finally broke free from the gentle land, feeling that his thoughts were clear and he felt refreshed.
He was neatly dressed, wearing a brand-new prince's python robe and a jade leather belt around his waist.
On the bed, Wu Lanxue still covered his head with a quilt, leaving only a head of black hair scattered on the pillow.
She was obviously exhausted.
Zhao Chenan did not disturb her and pushed the door straight out.
He had to see someone immediately.
His father, the sole ruler of the Zhou Dynasty—Zhao Daoting!
In the quiet moment after the wedding ceremony last night, he thought about many things.
The "Dao Tian Yan Jing" rewarded by the system is a heaven-grade skill!
This is a supreme treasure that is enough to make those high-ranking holy places and the Immortal God's Court think out of their wits!
According to his memory, the Great Zhou Dynasty was a dynasty, and the most advanced cultivation techniques of the royal family were nothing more than local products.
Tianpin Kung Fu is enough to change the destiny of the country!
And he, Zhao Chenan, is a Muggle who cannot practice, so he has no use for such techniques at all!
But he knew who could and must use it.
I want to enjoy wealth and honor safely in this world where the strong are respected.
And if you want to continuously marry more wives with excellent qualifications, you must find a towering tree that can shelter you from the wind and rain.
Looking at the entire Zhou Dynasty, who is the biggest backer?
There is no doubt that it is the emperor.
The father who pampered him to the point of being indulgent!
Therefore, Zhao Chenan decided to do something that was contrary to all the senior time travellers.
He wants a showdown!
No longer hide and tuck in, but take the initiative to expose yourself and get a great opportunity!
In exchange for this, I received my father’s full and unreserved support!
Of course, time travel and the system are the biggest secrets, and you can't tell them even if they are rotten in your stomach.
But he could change it to a more mysterious and more convincing statement for people in this world.
In this way, there is a perfect explanation for his offering of skills.
More importantly, he can completely tie his father, the current emperor, to his chariot!
Do you want the Great Zhou Dynasty to be promoted from a "dynasty", or even become a "celestial dynasty" overlooking a region?
Do you want to obtain stronger skills, break the shackles, and touch the legendary Immortal Stage?
Then help me find a wife!
Find the most beautiful and highly qualified woman in the world!
This plan is perfect!
Imperial Palace, Imperial Study Room.
Zhao Daoting, who was wearing a black dragon robe, was reviewing memorials. Next to him, Eunuch Wei, the eunuch, stood with his hands hanging down, breathing very lightly.
At this moment, a little eunuch ran in and knelt down to report.
"Your Majesty, His Highness the Sixteenth Prince is requesting an audience outside the palace."
Zhao Daoting paused slightly with his ink pen while reviewing the memorial.
Old Sixteen?
He raised his head, a look of surprise flashing across his face.
This treacherous son, apart from paying his respects as usual every month, doesn't even bother to enter the palace gate on weekdays. Is the sun rising in the west today?
Could it be that...this boy is dissatisfied with the Wolf Saint and came to complain to him?
There was a twinge of guilt in my heart.
This marriage really wronged him.
The most suitable candidate was the third prince who had not yet married his wife, but that bastard refused to comply.
The remaining adult princes either already had concubines, or their mothers had prominent family backgrounds and simply looked down upon a woman from a defeated tribe.
After picking and choosing, this "hard job" could only fall on his sixteenth son, Zhao Chenan, who was the least effective and had the least support.
"Let him in."
Zhao Daoting put down his ink pen and rubbed his brows, ready for his son's complaints.
At worst, reward him with more gold, silver and jewelry and let him go out and be happy.
Soon, Zhao Chenan, wearing a python robe, strode in.
"My son, please see your father."
Zhao Chenan bowed and saluted, his movements were clean and neat, and extremely standard, completely losing his usual carelessness and perfunctoryness.
Zhao Daoting looked at him, and before he could say the words of comfort he had prepared, he saw that Zhao Chenan had straightened up.
"Father, I have great responsibilities.Report the matter! "
Without waiting for Zhao Daoting to ask, Zhao Chenan spoke directly, with an unprecedented serious expression.
“This matter is related to the rise and fall of our Zhou Dynasty’s national destiny and the foundation of all generations! "
Zhao Daoting was stunned.
He looked at the solemn-looking son in front of him and even wondered if he had hallucinated because he had been reviewing the memorial for so long.
Is this still the bastard Old Sixteen who only knows how to fight cocks and lackeys and sleep on flowers and willows all day long?
The rise and fall of national destiny?
Wandai Foundation?
The words coming out of his mouth were even more outrageous than a sow climbing a tree!
"Chen An, what are you talking about? "
"Father! "
However, Zhao Chenan took a firm step forward, his eyes burning.
"Please step aside! "
The whole imperial study room was instantly audible.
The great eunuch Wei Eunuch looked at his nose with his eyes and his heart with his nose, like a sculpture without hearing.
Zhao Daoting's expression became serious.
He was silent for a moment and waved to Eunuch Wei.
"You all retreat and stay outside the temple. No one is allowed to come near. "
"Here. "
Eunuch Wei bowed to accept the order, quietly retreated out with a group of eunuchs and maids, and closed the heavy palace door with his own hands.
In the imperial study room, only the father and son were left.
Zhao Daoting sat back on the dragon chair, and a majestic majesty belonging to the emperor slowly spread out and enveloped the entire hall.
"Can we talk now? "
"What is it that makes you so mysterious? "
However, Zhao Chenan still did not speak.
He took a few steps forward, walked to the imperial court, and lowered his voice.
“Father, it’s not enough. "
Zhao Daoting's brows furrowed into the character "Chuan".
"My son, I sincerely request my father to use your cultivation to completely seal this place! "
"Make sure that our next conversation will not be detected by any being in any way! "
As soon as these words came out, Zhao Daoting's expression completely changed!
He stared at his son, and a terrifying aura suddenly rose from his body!
At that moment, Zhao Chenan felt an invisible giant pressing down on his head, and even his breathing became thick and stagnant.
The dust flying in the hall was frozen in mid-air at this moment!
His legs were weak uncontrollably, and his bones were groaning, but he still gritted his teeth.
He stubbornly faced his father's scrutinizing and sharp gaze.
He must show enough prudence to let his father understand that the seriousness of this matter is beyond imagination!
When the momentum that was enough to crush the mountains slowly subsided.
Zhao Daoting took a deep look at Zhao Chenan and didn't ask any questions. He just raised his hand and tapped his slender fingertips lightly in the void.
A golden ripple invisible to the naked eye centered on him, spread out silently, and enveloped the entire imperial study.
Space is completely blocked!
After doing all this, Zhao Daoting spoke again. Every word was as heavy as a thousand words, carrying unquestionable weight.
"Say. "
Zhao Chenan finally breathed a sigh of relief.
He didn't say another word of nonsense, and slowly stretched out his right hand in front of Zhao Daoting.
Under Zhao Daoting's suspicious gaze.
Zhao Chenan spread his palms.
No foreshadowing, no flashy special effects.
A simple, thick golden book appeared in his palm out of thin air!
On the cover of the classic, the five ancient seal characters of "Dao Tian Yan Sutra" flow with immortal charm, as if expounding the ultimate truth of the three thousand Dao!
Zhao Daoting suddenly stood up from the dragon chair, his eyes widened suddenly, his gaze fixed on the exercise book that appeared out of thin air!
The calmness and majesty of the emperor on his face were gone at this moment!
"Tianpin? ? ? "
